# Googlecontacts

Access and manage Google Contacts data via the Google People API

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/googlecontacts/.

## Actions

- **Modify Contact Group Members**: Modifies the members of a contact group by adding or removing contact resource names.
- **Batch create contacts**: Create a batch of new contacts in Google Contacts.
- **Batch Delete Google Contacts**: Delete a batch of contacts from Google Contacts.
- **Batch get contact groups** (read-only): Get a list of contact groups owned by the authenticated user by specifying a list of contact group resource names.
- **Batch get people** (read-only): Batch retrieves information about multiple people from Google Contacts.
- **Batch Update Google Contacts**: Update a batch of contacts in Google Contacts and return the updated contact data.
- **Copy Other Contact to My Contacts**: Copies an Other contact to a new contact in the user's myContacts group.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in Google Contacts and return the person resource for that contact.
- **Create Contact Group**: Create a new contact group owned by the authenticated user.
- **Delete contact group**: Deletes an existing contact group owned by the authenticated user by specifying the contact group resource name.
- **Delete Contact Photo**: Delete a contact's photo from Google Contacts.
- **Delete Google Contact**: Delete a contact person from Google Contacts.
- **Get Contact Group** (read-only): Retrieves a specific contact group owned by the authenticated user by specifying the contact group resource name.
- **Get Person** (read-only): Provides information about a person by specifying a resource name.
- **List Connections** (read-only): Lists the connections (contacts) for the authenticated user.
- **List Contact Groups** (read-only): List all contact groups owned by the authenticated user.
- **List Directory People** (read-only): Lists domain profiles and domain contacts in the authenticated user's domain directory.
- **List Other Contacts** (read-only): Lists "Other contacts" from Google People API.
- **Search Contacts** (read-only): Searches the authenticated user's contacts for matches against the provided query.
- **Search Domain Directory People** (read-only): Search domain directory people in Google Contacts.
- **Search Other Contacts** (read-only): Searches other contacts from Google People API that match a query string.
- **Update Contact Group**: Update the name of an existing contact group owned by the authenticated user.
- **Update Contact Photo**: Update a contact's photo.
- **Update Google Contact**: Update contact data for an existing contact person.
